findings.reason: Not arbitrary: the recipient is a registered pocket (proven as a kind-4 leaf of the envelope's payeeRoot, INV-14), the caller is the agent, the amount is capped by MAX_GAS_GRANT_PER_POCKET and the envelope cap, and the send is the native gas grant the spec requires (czar-vault.md §5.4, RV-004).
False positive: `_log` is a mapping; mappings need no initialisation, and every slot starts empty by design (open-evidence-log.md §6).
Intended rounding: `(l + 31) / 32 * 32` pads the string length to a whole ABI word, exactly as the czar-vault.md §6 layout table defines (672 + 32 × ⌈L / 32⌉).

`l.periodId == periodId` compares two period numbers (block.timestamp / PERIOD_LENGTH), not balances; equality is the intended test of whether the allowance belongs to the current period (czar-vault.md §5.6).
Intended default: `ok` starts false, so an unknown kind or a short signature returns EIP1271_INVALID (czar-vault.md §6, never revert).

Bounded: settle and finalize take at most FINALIZE_CHUNK (32) indices per call, and the call is a view read of USDC's authorizationState (czar-vault.md §5.3).
A pocket must be registered first, and registerPocket rejects address(0) (ZeroAddress); the same reason as the forge-lint comment on grantPocketGas (07 PRD 08 §7.3).

The event comes after the external call on purpose: czar-vault.md §15.5 fixes the order checks, effects, external call, event. The wrapper is nonReentrant (§15.5), all state is written before the call, and the escrow, Gateway and USDC addresses are immutables.
